tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Find UK car makes and models by name, e.g. "Fiesta", "Toyota Yaris" or "Kia". Returns up to 10 matches with their MOT reliability grade, first-time pass rate and the share of UK cars they beat, for get_model_reliability or get_make_reliability.

tools.name: get_make_reliability
tools.description: A make's MOT reliability grade over all its cars, and every graded model of that make ranked by the share of UK cars it beats once age and mileage are taken into account.

tools.name: get_model_reliability
tools.description: A model's MOT reliability over all years: grade, first-time pass rate, points above or below a typical car of the same age and mileage, and the share of UK cars it beats. Give year, fuel and/or engine to also get those versions, each with its own grade and the areas where it fails more often than si

tools.name: lookup_plate
tools.description: One UK car's MOT history from the DVSA by its registration: each test with its result, mileage and defects or advisories, whether its MOT is valid, warnings (mileage going down, gaps with no MOT, an outstanding safety recall) and its model's reliability grade.
